title: AI Operating System for Marketing Agencies
metaDescription: Managed AI operations for marketing agencies: connect lead response, onboarding, reporting and follow-up to approved business context and tools.
excerpt: An AI Operating System is the layer that runs the repeated work in the background for a marketing agency. Here is what we install, in what order, and what done looks like.

sections.intro:
Marketing agencies often repeat the same coordination around lead response, onboarding, reporting and follow-up. The work may be spread across inboxes, documents, project tools and individual memory.

An AI Operating System (AIOS) connects selected workflows to approved business context and tools. For a marketing agency, that can include eligible lead replies, consistent onboarding tasks, review-ready reports and scheduled briefs.

This page explains what we can install, in what order and how the work is measured.
sections.fourCFit:
An AIOS is built on four layers:

  • Context: approved offers, voice examples, processes and decision rules.
  • Connections: scoped access to the inbox, calendar, CRM, project tool and reporting sources.
  • Capabilities: workflows such as lead reply, kickoff preparation, report drafting and inbox triage.
  • Cadence: agreed schedules, triggers and stop conditions.

Context and Connections make later Capabilities more useful, while Cadence makes the workflow repeatable and reviewable.
sections.whatDoneLooksLike:
A completed marketing-agency system can include:

  • A personalized lead-reply workflow connected to your form, inbox and calendar. See 60-Second Lead Response for Marketing Agencies.
  • A repeatable onboarding workflow that creates the agreed kickoff materials and tasks.
  • Review-ready client-report drafts assembled from the data sources you approve.
  • Scheduled proposal follow-up that stops when a prospect replies.

The exact workflows and service levels are agreed during scope. You own the prompts, connections and automations built in your accounts.
sections.howWeInstall:
Three phases:

  1. Audit, free, about 10 minutes. Score your AI readiness across the Four Cs and surface high-leverage candidates for your agency. Run the audit.
  2. Install, with a standard target of 10 business days. We wire the agreed tools, capture your business context and ship the first scoped workflows.
  3. Operate, ongoing. We monitor, fix and improve the system against the baseline agreed at kickoff. See plans.
sections.expectedResults:
Results are measured against your own kickoff baseline rather than an invented industry average.

  • Lead reply time is measured from form submission to first response.
  • Reporting effort is measured before and after the agreed workflow.
  • Onboarding consistency is checked against the required tasks and materials.
  • Human overrides, failures and exceptions remain visible.

Paid plans include the published recovered-hours work guarantee. We do not promise revenue or conversion lift.
sections.faq:
Who owns the system?

You do. Every prompt, connection and automation lives in your accounts. If you stop working with us, you keep the system.

What if something breaks?

Monitoring and fixes are included in managed plans. You get alerts and a clear log of runs and failures.

How soon is the first workflow live?

The standard install target is 10 business days after the required access and business context are available. The actual scope and timeline are agreed before work starts.
